package.name: kislayphp_discovery
package.summary: KislayPHP Discovery provides a service registry for PHP.
package.description: KislayPHP Discovery provides a service registry for PHP. Part of the KislayPHP suite.
package.notes: Release 1.0.1: fixed heartbeat() being unable to revive an instance that had already been pruned by a resolve() call at the exact same staleness threshold used for selection - pruning now uses a longer grace window (3x heartbeat_timeout_ms) than resolve()'s own freshness check, so a briefly-stale instance stays revivable via heartbeat() instead of requiring full re-registration. Caught by tests/heartbeat_timeout_and_status_test.phpt.
